title: Criyson's Machinima
description: A modpack for all of your Minecraft Roleplay/Machinima needs!
body:
While machinima isn't that popular nowadays, it's still nice to mess around with mods meant for it. The contents of this modpack contains all the essentials for making a Minecraft Machinima/Roleplay. I hope you enjoy the modpack, and create great stuff!!


Non-Modrinth Mods:
(1.7.10)
1. [Bibliocraft - Nuchaz](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/bibliocraft)
2. [Chisel - tterrag1098](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/chisel)
3. [CMDCam - CreativeMD](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cmdcam)
4. [Pam's Harvest Craft - pamharvestcraft](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/pams-harvestcraft)
5. [WorldEdit - sk89q](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/worldedit)
